Situation Report — Day 27

  • Active strikes: US/Israeli airstrikes on Iranian targets continue. Iran, Hezbollah and Gaza-linked groups continue missile/rocket strikes and barrages toward Israel.
  • Air campaign & pauses
    • Trump announced a 2nd pause on Iran-directed energy strikes: 10 days, expires Apr 6, 2026 8PM ET. He says pause followed “Iranian Government request” and talks are “going very well.”
    • Iran publicly denies direct talks.
    • Context: first pause (5 days, Mar 23) was violated hours later by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr — risk of repeat violations is high.
  • Diplomacy
    • Pakistan mediating; Pakistani PM says talks concluded successfully and atmosphere was constructive.
    • US negotiator Vance reports Iran invited UN nuclear inspectors — tactical opening on oversight.
    • US authorized some Iranian oil sales amid talks — eases economic pressure temporarily.
  • Northern Border (Lebanon/Hezbollah)
    • Hezbollah active daily along the northern border. Cross-border fire and IDF responses continue.
    • Media reports Israel may announce a symbolic withdrawal from parts of southern Lebanon ahead of next talks.
  • Strait of Hormuz & shipping
    • Iran selectively reopened Hormuz to vessels from Russia, India and China while restricting others — using transit as political leverage.
  • International military moves
    • US Typhon missile launchers to remain in Japan after exercises — continued regional force posture.
  • Civilian incidents & economy
    • Localized violence continues (e.g., IDF shot dead two Palestinians during an attack near a settlement).
    • Energy/ticket markets reacting to talks and oil flow changes.
  • 🟢 Good News
    • A pause on energy strikes is in place for 10 days. Pakistan-mediated talks reported constructive. Iran reported to have invited UN inspectors. Some Iranian oil sales authorized — small de‑escalatory openings.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating
